title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Job Title: Accounts Administrator

Location: Warwick £13.45 per hour Temporary (until end of Feb 2026, with potential to extend) Office-based, Monday-Friday, 08:30-17:00

We're recruiting on behalf of a well-established, large organisation based in Warwick, currently seeking several Accounts Receivable Administrators to join their finance team on a temporary basis.

This is a great opportunity for someone with strong Excel skills and a keen eye for detail to get stuck into a busy, process-driven finance function, working as part of a small team to clear a backlog of cash allocation work. It would also suit a recent graduate or someone looking to gain hands-on exposure to a finance department, as full training will be given.

Key Responsibilities:
- Daily reconciliation and allocation of incoming customer payments against remittances for commercial accounts
- Contacting customers by phone and email to chase or clarify missing or unclear remittances
- Logging all activity and customer contact accurately in Salesforce
- Investigating and correcting misallocated payments
- Spotting anomalies in remittance data and proactively resolving discrepancies with customers

What We're Looking For:
- Confident using finance systems, with intermediate Excel skills (lookups, pivot tables, data manipulation)
- Strong numerical ability and comfort working with financial data
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- Clear, professional communicator, both internally and with external customers
- Able to stay focused and accurate on repetitive, high-volume tasks

The Details:
- Full-time, office-based role in Warwick
- Monday to Friday, 08:30-17:00 (1 hour for lunch)
- Temporary assignment running to 28th February 2026, with strong possibility of extension
- Multiple positions available - great opportunity for immediate starts

title: Customer Supply Coordinator
description:
Hybrid Full Time Permanent

About the Role

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Customer Supply Coordinator to join a busy supply chain operation based in Warwick, UK. The role will take responsibility for order planning, key account fulfilment and delivery coordination, helping to maximise product availability while managing logistics efficiently and cost-effectively.

Working closely with customers, supply sources, logistics providers, sales and finance teams, you will coordinate end-to-end supply requirements and support a high standard of customer service. This position would suit an analytical and commercially minded professional with experience in supply chain planning, order management, logistics or key account support, together with strong Excel skills.

Duties & Responsibilities
- Take ownership of order planning and order management for key customer accounts, using established processes alongside account-specific requirements.
- Coordinate cross-functional activity between customers, supply sources, logistics providers, sales and finance teams to maintain effective order fulfilment.
- Work closely with customers and internal teams to maximise product availability in line with demand, agreed targets and commercial campaigns.
- Use SAP and Microsoft Excel to combine datasets, analyse information and produce accurate internal and external reports.
- Proactively plan and communicate delivery requirements with third-party logistics providers (3 PLs), identifying opportunities to improve availability and logistics efficiency.
- Investigate delivery discrepancies and coordinate appropriate solutions while balancing customer service requirements with operational costs.
- Build productive relationships with internal and external partners while proactively managing customer enquiries through to resolution.
- Support key account performance through strong commercial awareness, effective communication and an understanding of customer requirements.

Education & Skills Required
- Previous relevant experience in supply chain, planning, order management, logistics, key account support or a related business environment, or a relevant educational qualification.
- Supply chain, key account support or business-related education is advantageous, although no specific degree is required.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Power BI and SAP would be beneficial, but is not essential.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving and critical-thinking skills, with excellent accuracy and attention to detail.
- Confident communication, negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with internal teams, customers and external partners.
- Strong organisational and commercial skills, with the ability to prioritise multiple responsibilities, adapt to changing requirements and travel when business needs require it.

Hours: 9:00am - 5:30pm
Location: Leamington Spa.
Working Pattern: Hybrid - 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home, with flexibility.

If you have the planning, analytical and customer-focused skills to succeed as a Customer Supply Coordinator, apply today. This is an excellent opportunity to develop your supply chain career within a collaborative international working environment.

For a discreet, detailed discussion about the role, you can reach out to Vanessa Rodriguez at or email

title: HR Assistant
description:
We are working exclusively with a well-known, European leading organisation on the lookout for a HR Assistant to join their team in Warwick. This is an incredible opportunity to join a great company within a fantastic team.

This role will be responsible for managing the administration for the whole employee life cycle, for all employees split over two business units. Providing a proactive and efficient HR administrative service that supports the overall objectives of the department. Acting as the point of contact for all first level HR issues, ensuring correct procedures are followed; documented where applicable and excellent service is provided to all stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:
- To be the first point of contact for all HR queries - providing guidance and support to managers and/or employees in line with company policies and procedures and statutory provisions
- Maintaining an efficient and effective new starter process from point of offer through to onboarding, ensuring that the set HR procedure is followed and all associated electronic and paper based information is inputted in a timely manner
- Maintain all updates on the HR management systems (SAP; Success Factors and Umantis) and all other internal HR systems)
- Ensuring a strong link is maintained between HR and Payroll and all associated documentation is submitted with accuracy and on time
- Providing a general administrative service for the HR department, including but not limited to:
- Generating letters, contracts and ensuring statutory process adherence
- Updating KPI information and generating ad hoc statistical reporting
- Respond to external and internal information requests
- Supporting projects and completion of HR objectives
- Assisting with the recruitment process, from applicant tracking through to assisting with first level assessments
- Processing invoices & monitoring departmental budgetary spend
- Conducting exit interviews
- General office duties such as the upkeep of personnel records and maintaining the H.R filing and archive system, standards forms and compliance with GDPR
- Provide support with the facilitation of training - source and arrange course enrolment, gather information to produce training agreements and maintain records of training undertaken.
- Provide advice and guidance to managers, supporting on first level employee relations issues
- Managing and supporting the recruitment process including administration and first level assessment support
- Undertake projects as and when required in line with the objectives of the role

Key Requirements:
- Previous administration experience in a fast-paced commercial business
- Dealing with confidential subject matter
- Experience working with SAP
- Knowledge and ability to offer first line HR advice in relation to current legislation
- Experience working with multiple stakeholders and competing deadlines
- Managed a high level of recruitment activity
- First level HR advice, e.g. performance issues, ER, coaching
- HR Degree (or equivalent HR qualification)
- Confidence to deal with people internally and externally at all levels
- Ability to use own initiative and learn quickly
- Ability to prioritise own work levels

title: P2P Supply Chain Planner
description:
Role- P2 P Planner

Location: Warwickshire
Reporting to: P2 P Lead

About the Role

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented P2 P Planner to join a dynamic supply chain team based in Warwick. This role is responsible for managing order planning and fulfilment activities across a portfolio of key customer accounts, ensuring products are supplied efficiently and cost-effectively.

Working closely with manufacturing sites, logistics providers, sales teams and finance functions, you will coordinate end-to-end supply activities to maximise product availability and deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Key ResponsibilitiesOrder Planning & Supply Coordination
- Take ownership of order management activities for a portfolio of key customer accounts, balancing standard processes with specific customer requirements.
- Coordinate cross-functional activities between manufacturing sites, logistics providers, sales and finance teams to ensure smooth order fulfilment.
- Work closely with customers, sales teams and logistics operations to maintain strong product availability and support consumer demand.
- Ensure supply plans align with customer forecasts, agreed service targets and promotional activity.
- Utilise SAP and Excel to analyse data, generate reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders.

Delivery Management
- Proactively plan and communicate delivery requirements with third-party logistics providers.
- Identify opportunities to improve delivery performance, increase availability and optimise logistics costs.
- Manage and resolve delivery discrepancies, implementing effective solutions while balancing service levels and cost considerations.

Customer & Stakeholder Management
- Build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders to support business growth and customer satisfaction.
- Take ownership of customer enquiries and proactively manage issues through to resolution.
- Act as a trusted representative of the business, developing a strong understanding of products, customers and market requirements.

Skills & ExperienceEssential
- Previous experience within Supply Chain, Planning, Customer Service, Key Account Support or a related business function.
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to interpret and manipulate data.
- Intermediate Microsoft Excel skills, with experience using PowerPoint. Knowledge of Power BI would be advantageous.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Strong problem-solving capabilities and attention to detail.
- Commercial awareness with a customer-focused mindset.
- Ability to influence and build effective relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
- Flexible and adaptable approach to changing business requirements.

Qualifications
- No specific degree is required. Applications are welcomed from individuals with a range of educational and professional backgrounds who can demonstrate strong analytical ability, curiosity and a willingness to learn.
- A qualification in Supply Chain, Business, Logistics or a related discipline would be beneficial.
- Approximately 2+ years of relevant industry experience or an equivalent qualification.

What's on Offer

Salary £30,000-£33,000
- Structured onboarding and support to help you succeed in the role.
- Ongoing learning and development opportunities.
- Regular coaching and mentorship.
- Exposure to a global and fast-paced business environment.
- A collaborative and inclusive culture where diversity is valued.
- Opportunities to contribute to sustainability and community initiatives.
- A strong focus on employee wellbeing, work-life balance and long-term career development.

If you're looking to develop your career within supply chain planning and enjoy working in a collaborative, customer-focused environment, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Property Litigation Paralegal
description:

Client Details

This professional services firm is based in Warwickshire and operates in the legal sector.

Description

- Assist solicitors with case preparation and legal research.
- Communicate with clients, keeping them updated on case progress.
- Manage case files and ensure all documentation is accurately maintained.
- Liaise with external parties such as surveyors and opposing legal teams.
- Monitor and adhere to deadlines for court filings and submissions.
- Provide administrative support to the wider legal team as needed

Profile

A successful Property Litigation Paralegal should have:
- Previous litigation experience is advantageous.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Proactive and professional approach to work.
- Genuine interest in property litigation and contentious matters.

Job Offer
- Permanent position within the legal sector.
- Additional benefits to be confirmed.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.
